verdict: SPINOR DOUBLE COVER DISCOVERED: a net learns the 720-degree interference cos(alpha/2) (R2 1.000) from the continuous rotation parameter, but a net restricted to the lab-frame observable (cos a, sin a) CANNOT (R2 -0.00) -- no 2pi-periodic input yields a 4pi output. Over the SAME lab orientation the spinor-net gives OPPOSITE predictions (sheet diff 1.27; bloch-net forced to 0.00) -- two sheets, with -1 at 360deg and +1 at 720deg: 720 degrees to return. The double cover is a holonomy of the continuous rotation, invisible to single-time spin measurements (cousin of AB/Berry).
